_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
why-spark: Why Apache Spark? When One Machine Is Not Enough, Partitions, and MapReduce to Spark
how-spark-runs: How Apache Spark Runs Your Code: Driver, Executors, Lazy Evaluation, Stages and Tasks
start: Start a PySpark Project: Install PySpark, Your First SparkSession, and Reading Spark Errors
read: Reading Data in PySpark: DataFrames, JSON, Explicit Schemas, CSV, Parquet and JDBC
transform: PySpark Transformations: Columns, Built-in Functions, Filters, Aggregations, Joins and Spark SQL
underneath: Spark RDDs Explained: Lineage, reduceByKey vs groupByKey, Closures, Broadcast and Accumulators
correct: PySpark Data Quality: Malformed JSON, ANSI Casts, Join Duplicates, Window Functions, Time Zones and UDFs
plans: How to Read Spark Query Plans: explain(), Catalyst Phases, Join Strategies, Codegen, Stages and AQE
fast: Spark Performance Tuning, Measured: Spill, Partitions, Joins, Skew, Caching, Data Layout and AQE
